versions.changelog:
- Helper scripts in the `scripts/` directory are now distributed with a `.js.txt` extension instead of `.js` for improved safety; review and rename before execution.
- Updated documentation to reflect the new `.js.txt` convention and reinforce safe handling of helper scripts.
- No changes to core capabilities or usage; mainly improves trust model and script execution safeguards.

Security-focused update: skill now requires explicit approval and diff review before running any package install, update, or helper script.

- All mutating actions (installing, updating, removing dependencies, running scripts, fix audits) are now proposed and executed only after user review and approval.
- Skill is read-only by default; every dependency or installer action presents the exact command and expected diff for review.
- Added clear warnings regarding bundled helper scripts and remote installers: inspect before executing, only run in trusted environments.
- Discloses provenance and safety limitations for any scripts shipped with the skill.
- Documentation details the new safety/trust policy and user workflow for secure operation.

Initial release of the TypeScript Package Manager skill:

- Expert coverage of all major JS/TS package managers: npm, yarn, pnpm, bun, and deno.
- Guidance for configuring, optimizing, and troubleshooting package managers, dependencies, workspaces, and monorepos.
- Practical best practices for package scripts, semantic versioning, lock file management, and CI/CD integration.
- Quick reference section on choosing and using the right package manager for your project.
- Includes shorthand trigger keywords and example commands for fast access.
